title: Test Run
description: A tiny story that exercises every beat type. Not part of the real game.

cards.title: Your situation
cards.text: {money} in your pocket. Phone on 3%. And {debt} that is not yours, but is somehow yours.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The night bus spits you out under the flyover. Somebody is already shouting "Oshodi! Oshodi! Enter with your change!"

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Ehen. New face. You dey look the bus stop like say e owe you money. Who be you?

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: Good morning sir. My name na {name}.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: {name}? Street no dey call person by government name. Until you earn your name, na JJC we go call you. Johnny Just Come.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Rule number zero: nothing free for Lagos. Even advice. My throat dry o.

options.text: Buy Professor tea from Mallam Garba
"Sir, I no even get for myself."
Call him "Baba" and ask for his blessing
options.lockedText: You never reach that level with Professor

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Hmm. We go see.

variants.text: Ahhh. This boy get home training. Sit down, make I teach you something.

beats.headline: FUEL PRICE GO UP AGAIN
beats.text: Government say the new price na "temporary permanent adjustment". Drivers dey vex. Baba Radio turn the volume up, as if loud news fit reduce the price.

beats.speaker: biodun
beats.text: Professor, abeg, I go pay tomorrow! Tomorrow by God's grace!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Driver Bíọ́dún jumps into his danfo, "God's Time Is The Best", and pulls off without paying the stop fee.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Oga, that driver don run again. You go chase am or you go let am go? Quick quick!

options.text: Let am go, na small money

beats.speaker: biodun
beats.text: Okay o! Okay! Take your ₦500. Na today you wan collect am, abi?

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: See leg! You run like person wey NEPA take light from. Baba Ticket go hear of this.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Ehn ehn. Danfo don pass you like say you be bus stop sign. You need to eat something.

beats.speaker: professor
beats.text: Soft heart. Baba Ticket no go like am, but the drivers go talk am for park. Sometimes that one better pass money.

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Customer or trouble? Because you no resemble customer.

variants.text: See as rain soak you like agbalumo. Come stand for my shade before you catch cold. Customer or trouble?

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Na me be Ada. This na Ada's Corner. Anything you wan buy, I get am. Anything you wan talk, I get ear, but e no free.

options.text: Help Ada carry her cartons inside
"Fine girl like you, you get boyfriend?"
Ask Ada for goods on credit
options.lockedText: Ada no know you reach to give you credit

beats.speaker: ada
beats.text: Thank you o. At least you get hand. Plenty men for this market get only mouth.

variants.text: Boyfriend? I get JAMB. That one dey disturb me pass any man. Come back when you get your own shop.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Night. The generators start their choir. You sit under the flyover with Professor.

beats.speaker: mama
beats.text: {name}, Iya Bọ́sẹ̀ come house again today. I tell am say you don find work for Lagos. You don find work, abi?
How you wan end this test day?

options.text: "Yes Mama. Work don start." (Sleep under the flyover)
Tell Mama everything and give up (test ending)

beats.title: End of the Test Run
beats.summary: You survived your first test day with {money} in your pocket. Ada bond: {stat:friendBond}. Professor bond: {stat:mentorBond}.
